scope: Original Plex scan/filter/sample bodies, all library/items/media metadata supplied as in-memory fixtures. Device collision synthetic. No Plex client, auth, server, filesystem, network or refresh calls executed.

authored_controls.name: separate same-title entries with one version each omitted
empty media parts count as non-sample version
same show episode key overwrites earlier multi-version item
hardlink filter ignores devices with identical inode
sample substring in parent excludes arbitrary content
